title: DataResponse
summary: Typed data accompanied by HTTP status and headers.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body: Contains value: T, init: ResponseInit, and the __routeData discriminator. Construct it with data(value, init), rather than constructing the marker object yourself.

sections.title: Usage and limits
sections.body: RouteData unwraps the value type. Application transport serializes the value; direct resource responses and page action HTML preserve the provided status and headers. Use redirect(...) for navigation, not a DataResponse with a Location header.
